# CSNL Module Picker

> Free, independent timetable builder for UCD's Computer Science (Negotiated Learning)
> master's: every CSNL module with live UCD class times, a clash-free weekly grid, a
> credit-target plan builder and an exam-free filter. Not an official UCD service.

Live site: https://ucdcsnlmodulepicker.pages.dev/
Source: https://github.com/parth-soni-10/UCD-CSNL-Module_Picker
Maintainer: Parth Soni - soni.soni.parth@gmail.com
Cost: free, no account, no cookies, no analytics.

## When to use this

Use this site when the task is one of these:

- **Choosing CSNL modules for a year.** Every module on UCD's CSNL streams list is shown with
  credits, core/optional status, semester and the lecturer's comments.
- **Checking whether two modules clash.** Selecting modules draws a weekly grid; overlapping
  classes are flagged. Same-time classes in different trimesters are not a clash, because they
  never run together.
- **Finding a combination that hits a credit target.** The planner searches for clash-free sets at
  30, 60 or 90 credits, optionally avoiding 9am starts, Fridays or too many classes in a day.
- **Avoiding final exams.** Assessment components from each module's UCD page drive an exam-free
  filter and a no-final-exam plan mode.
- **Reading a module's live timetable.** Day, time, weeks, trimester and room come from UCD's
  General Reference Timetable for the current academic year.
- **Comparing candidate selections.** Several named timetables can be kept and exported to JSON.

Do **not** use it for registration, degree audits, exam timetables, fees or visa questions, or
modules outside the CSNL list. UCD's own systems decide what a student may register for.
"Exam-free" means no final exam was found on the module page; it is a filter, not a guarantee
about continuous assessment.

## How to call it

HTML, Markdown and JSON, all unauthenticated:

- `GET /` with `Accept: text/markdown` → this site's Markdown home; with `Accept: text/html` → the app.
  HTML responses carry `Vary: Accept` and a `Link` alternate.
- `/index.md`, `/about.md`, `/contact.md`, `/privacy.md` → always Markdown.
- An unknown path with `Accept: text/markdown` → HTTP 404 with a Markdown body that links this
  file and the sitemap. As HTML it returns the site's 404 page, also with HTTP 404.

JSON endpoints (same deployment, no key, no cookies):

- `GET /.netlify/functions/catalogue` →
  `{ source, pageUpdated, generatedAt, verified, themes: [{ theme, courses: [{ name, credits, kind,
  semester, comments }] }] }`. `name` contains the module code in parentheses. `?action=health`
  returns freshness and counts only.
- `GET /.netlify/functions/timetable?codes=COMP30960,COMP30030` → live timings for up to 80 codes:
  `{ generatedAt, source, cacheTTLMinutes, results: { CODE: { found, title, year, semester,
  trimesters, classes: [{ day, startTime, endTime, room, weeks, term }] } }, errors }`. A module UCD
  has not timetabled answers `found: true` with a `reason` and no classes; a code outside the CSNL
  list answers `found: false`; a request with no codes answers HTTP 400.
- `GET /.netlify/functions/assessments` → assessment map from UCD module pages (`?force=1` refreshes).
- `POST /.netlify/functions/suggestions` → the site's suggestion form (`name`, `email`,
  `suggestion`). Not a general-purpose API.

`semester` is `"1"` (Autumn), `"2"` (Spring) or `"1, 2"`. A class's `term` is the trimester(s) its
weeks fall in.

```bash
curl -sS -H 'Accept: text/markdown' https://ucdcsnlmodulepicker.pages.dev/
curl -sS https://ucdcsnlmodulepicker.pages.dev/index.md
curl -sS 'https://ucdcsnlmodulepicker.pages.dev/.netlify/functions/timetable?codes=COMP30960'
```

## How it works

1. UCD's CSNL streams page supplies the module list, streams, credits, kind, semester and comments;
   UCD's module catalogue fills in descriptions. The result is cached in KV, re-checked per request
   and refreshed twice a month, with a committed list as the last-resort fallback.
2. Each selected code is resolved against UCD's General Reference Timetable for the current
   academic year only. No published year means the module says so rather than showing old times.
3. Clashes are computed from day, start, end and shared trimester. Semesters are kept apart.
4. Selections, named timetables, theme and cached timings live in the visitor's `localStorage`.

## Limits

- Not an official UCD service; it cannot register a student or change a record.
- CSNL modules only. The timetable endpoint refuses codes outside the current list.
- One academic year at a time (UCD advances it around 1 August).
- UCD is the source of truth; when it is unreachable the site reports the failure instead of
  serving a stale timetable.
- The module list changes yearly, so it is never repeated here - read the catalogue endpoint.
